title: Reverse a Linked List
statementMd:
Complete `reverse(Node head)` so it reverses a singly linked list **in place** (by re-pointing the `next` links — no arrays, no new nodes) and returns the new head. `main` builds the list and prints the result.

**Input**
Line 1: `n` (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000). Line 2: n integers.

**Output**
The reversed list, space-separated.
hints: Keep three pointers: prev (starts null), cur (starts at head), and next.
In the loop: save next = cur.next, point cur.next back to prev, then move prev and cur one step forward. Return prev.
